jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The B2B Technical Project Manager
is responsible for leading customer integration projects and supporting the development and implementation of scalable B2B integration solutions between Avantor and its customers.

This role manages technical integration projects throughout the project lifecycle, partners with internal and external stakeholders, evaluates existing business processes and technologies, and identifies opportunities to improve the customer Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash experience.

The B2B Technical Project Manager will also contribute to the development of Avantor's long-term integration strategy, including future connectivity with customer and supplier eProcurement platforms and external portals.

What We're Looking For

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in related discipline or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
5+ years of relevant experience in technical project management, B2B integrations, eCommerce, eProcurement, or a related area.
Experience managing technical integration projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Experience working with common customer eProcurement platforms such as Ariba Network, JAGGAER, Hubwoo, Coupa, Oracle Supplier Network, Unimarket, Perfect Commerce, ExpenseWatch, ESM or similar platforms.

THOSE NECESSARY TO PERFORM THE JOB COMPETENTLY

Technical Knowledge And Skills

Solid understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes.
Strong understanding of B2B integration formats, technologies, and protocols including EDI, cXML, XML, and APIs web services.
Experience with eProcurement integration processes and technologies, including cXML / OCI PunchOut and AS2.
Working knowledge of integration best practices and experience supporting SAP or similar ERP environments.
Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable integration solutions.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to effectively facilitate meetings and conference calls with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-Motivated and results-oriented, with strong attention to detail while maintaining perspective on broader business objectives.

How You Will Thrive And Create An Impact

Serve as a primary technical liaison between Avantor, customers, and internal teams for B2B integration initiatives.
Lead customer integration projects from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and project closeout.
Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, technical capabilities, and integration needs.
Develop, document, and continuously improve standardized B2B integration procedures and implementation practices.
Analyze current business processes, systems and integration technologies and recommend opportunities for process or system improvements.
Lead internal and external project teams by establishing project plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring deliverables, and managing timelines.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential issues and coordinate appropriate resolution or escalation.
Ensure projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and within agreed-upon timelines.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with customers, project teams, technology partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Support the development of Avantor's future-state B2B integration strategy, including integrations with external eProcurement and supplier platforms.
Maintain appropriate project documentation and provide regular project status updates to stakeholders.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career.
Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better.
It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. Apply today!

Pay Transparency

The expected pre-tax pay for this position is

$78,000.00 - $125,350.00

Actual pay may differ depending on relevant factors such as prior experience and geographic location.

EEO Statement

We are an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/province, or local law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at recruiting@avantorsciences.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, please view the Know Your Rights poster.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager Digital Banking Transformation

100% Remote (Candidates that reside in Pacific Standard Time are priority)

Target Duration: Funded through the end of 2026 with strong potential for extension based on project demand and performance. This role supports multiple strategic digital banking initiatives that are expected to continue beyond the current statement of work.

This Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to support a large-scale Digital Banking Transformation program focused on enhancing customer-facing digital channels including mobile banking applications, online banking platforms, digital onboarding, payments, and customer experience initiatives.
This is a highly visible role supporting multiple strategic initiatives within a fast-paced financial services environment.
The ideal candidate will bring strong project delivery experience, deep Agile expertise, and proven experience leading digital banking transformation efforts.

Important: Read Before Applying

Role

This is not a high-level Program Manager role. This role requires a hands-on Senior Project Manager who is willing to get into the details and personally drive execution every day. Candidates who are successful in this environment are those who:

Build and maintain detailed project plans
Manage project financials and forecasting
Maintain RAID logs and risk registers
Facilitate Agile ceremonies and planning sessions
Drive action items to completion
Manage dependencies across teams
Take detailed meeting notes
Follow up with stakeholders
Coordinate testing, readiness, and implementation activities
Help organize and facilitate quarterly planning events
Focus on outcomes and delivery rather than simply reporting status

This is an execution-focused role. Candidates that prefer to stay at a strategic or portfolio level will not be successful in this environment.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have experience within retail banking, credit unions, fintech, digital banking, or financial services environments.

Senior Project Management Experience

Candidates Must Have Experience Leading Complex, Enterprise-scale Projects Involving

Cross-functional teams
Multiple stakeholders
Project financial management
Resource planning
Risk management
Delivery governance
Full project lifecycle ownership

Agile / Scrum Experience

Strong Experience With

Agile methodologies
Scrum frameworks
Sprint planning
Backlog management
Quarterly planning
Release planning
Cross-team dependency management

Digital Banking Transformation Experience

Candidates Must Have Direct Experience Supporting Initiatives Such As

Mobile Banking Applications
Online Banking Platforms
Digital Account Opening
Customer/Member Digital Experiences
Digital Payments
Lending Platforms
Digital Self-Service Capabilities
Banking Channel Modernization

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

Lead complex, cross-functional Digital Banking Transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and closure.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, budgets, and forecasts.
Manage project scope, timeline, financials, risks, and dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Coordinate delivery activities across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, QA, and Business stakeholders.

Agile Delivery

Facilitate Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Retrospectives, Daily Standups, and Release Planning activities.
Support Agile teams through execution and removal of delivery blockers.
Prepare and facilitate Quarterly Planning and roadmap sessions.
Drive delivery accountability across multiple workstreams.

Governance & Communication

Maintain detailed RAID logs, action registers, dependency trackers, and executive reporting.
Prepare status reports, executive updates, dashboards, and steering committee materials.
Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate critical decision-making discussions.
Ensure projects comply with established methodologies, governance standards, and best practices.

Risk & Implementation Management

Identify and mitigate delivery risks before they impact milestones.
Coordinate testing, implementation readiness, deployment activities, and post-production stabilization.
Manage issue escalation and cross-functional problem-solving efforts.
Ensure successful delivery of measurable business outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate:

Is highly organized and execution-focused
Enjoys solving problems and removing blockers
Is comfortable driving accountability across teams
Thrives in fast-paced, high-visibility environments
Takes ownership of outcomes
Is equally comfortable discussing strategy and managing day-to-day execution details
Understands that project success comes from discipline, follow-through, and strong stakeholder management

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Tukwila, WA.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $65.00 - $80.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: Medical, dental & vision Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital 401(k) Retirement Plan Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents) Short and long-term disability Health Spending Account (HSA) Transportation benefits Employee Assistance Program Time Off/Leave (PTO, Vacation or Sick Leave)

Workplace Type

This is a fully remote position.

jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics Business Central & AI Project Manager & IT Leader Prospect
jobs.description:
Ka Resources Recruitment sta cercando, per conto di
una solida e strutturata realtà multinazionale, parte di un prestigioso gruppo internazionale leader nel settore industriale manifatturiero, un Microsoft Dynamics BC & AI Project Manager. La persona entrerá a far parte del Team IT interno e colleborerá, insieme all’IT Manager (di cui raccoglierá il testimone una volta in pensione), ad un'importante fase di trasformazione digitale.
La sede dell’azienda si trova in provincia di Milano, a 4km a Sud di Legnano.
Il Ruolo:

La risorsa inserita avrà la responsabilità iniziale di supportare, presidiare e portare a successo il completamento della migrazione da MS Dynamics NAV verso Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central oltreché implementare e sviluppare progetti strutturati legati all'Intelligenza Artificiale . É considerata fondamentale la capacità di guidare l'introduzione e lo sviluppo di progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale all'interno dell'organizzazione.

Inoltre, in un'ottica di pianificazione della successione e crescita interna, il candidato affiancherà l'attuale governance per assumere progressivamente la responsabilità, il coordinamento e la gestione strategica del team IT (attualmente composto da 4 professionisti: IT Manager, Sistemista, Service Desk e Developer).
Responsabilità Principali:

• Coordinare e presidiare il progetto di migrazione e il Go-Live verso Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, interfacciandosi con i partner esterni e gli stakeholder interni.
• Analizzare i processi aziendali dal punto di vista funzionale e progettuale, ottimizzando l'adozione dell'ERP.
• Sviluppare e ottimizzare l'area di Business Intelligence, occupandosi dell'analisi dei dati e della creazione di strumenti di reporting avanzati a supporto delle decisioni strategiche.
• Identificare, progettare e implementare soluzioni concrete di Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) applicate all'efficientamento dei processi aziendali.
• Guidare, motivare e coordinare progressivamente il team IT interno, definendo priorità e obiettivi strategici.
Requisiti Richiesti:

• Consolidata esperienza nel ruolo di Project Manager ERP, con focus specifico e approfondito su Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (competenze sia funzionali in area operations, sia di gestione del progetto).
• Competenza comprovata nell'ambito della Business Intelligence e data analysis per la creazione di reportistica direzionale.
• Esperienze tangibili e competenze concrete nell'integrazione di tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) applicate ai flussi di lavoro aziendali.
• Aver giá sviluppato e introdotto in azienda progetti AI con applicazioni pratiche e risultati comprovabili.

• Padronanza di Microsoft Copilot in Business Central:
Il candidato deve conoscere come configurare e sfruttare le funzionalità AI integrate.
• Estensione tramite Power Platform e Azure AI:
Capacità di guidare progetti che integrano Business Central con Power Automate
e modelli di Azure OpenAI
per l'analisi predittiva o la classificazione documentale.
• Ottima esperienza dei processi aziendali in realtá manifatturiere, area operations: pianificazione, magazzino, acquisti, lavorazioni, assemblaggio.
• Spiccate capacità organizzative, di leadership e attitudine manageriale, mirate alla futura gestione e al coordinamento di risorse umane.
• Mentalità orientata al problem solving, ottime doti relazionali e capacità di visione strategica.

Orario di lavoro:
Full-time, 08:30 - 12:15 e 13:15 - 17:30 (con flessibilità in entrata fino alle 09:00).
Inquadramento:
CCNL Metalmeccanico
Modalità di lavoro:
Ibrida (1 giorno alla settimana di smartworking).
Retribuzione annua lorda:
da 55k a 65k + un premio variabile annuale collettivo + premio produzione 774,72 all’anno dopo 3 anni di lavoro.

jobs.title: Project Manager | Workplace & Furniture
jobs.description:
Van een goed idee naar een werkplek die klopt. Jij regelt het.

Bij FacilitylinQ helpen we organisaties om inspirerende en praktische werkomgevingen te creëren. Van productselectie tot levering werken we samen met meer dan 500 toonaangevende meubel- en designmerken. Kwaliteit, service en duurzaamheid staan centraal in wat we doen.
Heb jij gevoel voor interieur, ben je commercieel ingesteld en krijg je energie van organiseren? Wil je projecten begeleiden waarvan je het resultaat écht kunt zien? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.
Jouw rol

Als Projectmanager breng jij plannen tot leven. Je vertaalt klantafspraken naar een duidelijke planning en zorgt dat klanten, leveranciers en collega’s weten wat er moet gebeuren. Je schakelt met Sales en Operations, houdt overzicht en pakt door als iets anders loopt dan gepland.
Van de overdracht door Sales tot de oplevering: jij bewaakt de planning, het budget, de kwaliteit en de projectmarge. Een tevreden klant én een goed projectresultaat? Daar ga jij voor.
Wat ga je doen?

·      Projecten voorbereiden, plannen en begeleiden: van een offerte tot laatste opleverpunt.
·      Het aanspreekpunt zijn voor klanten, leveranciers en uitvoerende partners.
·      Inkoop, leveringen, logistiek en montage op elkaar afstemmen.
·      Grip houden op voortgang, budget, kwaliteit en marge.
·      Knelpunten vroeg herkennen, oplossingen regelen en afspraken maken over meer/minderwerk.
·      Projectinformatie actueel houden en zorgen dat iedereen op de hoogte blijft.
·      De oplevering en nazorg zorgvuldig afronden.
Wat breng je mee?

Je houdt van aanpakken, werkt nauwkeurig en kunt meerdere zaken tegelijk overzien. Je communiceert makkelijk, denkt in oplossingen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk.
Daarnaast:
·      Heb je minimaal twee jaar ervaring in B2B-met interieur(gerelateerde) producten.
·      Combineer je commercieel inzicht met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden.
·      Werk je gestructureerd en heb je oog voor detail.
·      Spreek je vloeiend Nederlands en beheers je het Engels goed.
·      Woon je in de omgeving van Amsterdam.
Wat bieden wij?

·      Afwisselende werkplekprojecten voor uiteenlopende klanten.
·      Werken met toonaangevende internationale meubel- en designmerken.
·      Een ondernemende, praktische werkomgeving waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn.
·      Hybride werken: je werkt zowel op kantoor als thuis.
·      Ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen en te groeien in je vak.
·      Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Klaar om jouw volgende project op te pakken?

We horen graag wat jij meebrengt. Stuur ons je cv en een korte toelichting op waarom deze rol bij je past. We maken graag kennis met je!

jobs.title: Scientific Project Manager
jobs.description:
For over 40 years, our shared commitment to curing childhood cancer has united us. Together, we continue to accelerate the answers to make that possible.

To accomplish our vision, we’re seeking someone who lives our values: owning and delivering meaningful work, collaborating to drive impact, challenging the status quo to create a better future, and balancing logic with empathy. Let’s achieve more, together.

The Scientific Project Manager is one of a small group of project management roles established to progress the science of within ZERO. The Zero Childhood Cancer Program (ZERO) is Australia’s most comprehensive precision medicine program for children and young people with cancer.

This role combines scientific expertise with project management and internal stakeholder coordination. You will project manage scientific projects, research initiatives and research outputs; coordinate and synthesise scientific data, literature and project findings; manage manuscript planning, development, review and submission; and contributes to grant development and scientific input for funding applications and program deliverables. The Scientific Project Manager works across clinical, molecular and genomic datasets and brings together clinicians, scientists, bioinformaticians, professional services teams and external collaborators.

To succeed you will have…

Postgraduate degree (PhD or MSc) in cancer biology, molecular biology, genomics, biomedical science or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience working within translational or biomedical research environments.
Demonstrated experience project managing or coordinating complex scientific projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent deliverables.
Experience supporting manuscript development, scientific reporting or grant-related activities.
Working knowledge of clinical and molecular research datasets, including genomic and multi-omics data.
Experience working effectively with clinicians, researchers, bioinformaticians and operational teams.

We will support you to be your best with benefits that include but are not limited to:

Working in a world-class, purpose-built facility, the only one in Australia dedicated to curing childhood cancer
Focus on employee wellbeing, including up to 5 gifted wellbeing days off (paid) per year
Access to Fitness Passport, with access to an extensive choice of fitness facilities across Sydney at discounted rates
Corporate discounts and discounts on education through UNSW

Join us to shape a future every child deserves and to find meaning in your own. Because together, we can cure every child of cancer. It’s not if, it’s when.

Additional information about Children's Cancer Institute can be found on our website at: https://www.ccia.org.au/jobs-study . We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Children’s Cancer Institute and our culture. We embrace diversity and encourage you to advise of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Global PMO

POSITION: Program Manager I, Prevention & Youth

DEPARTMENT: Community Wellness Department (CWD)

REPORTS TO: Senior Program Manager

LOCATION: Native American Health Center, Inc. (NAHC)

WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE

STATUS: Non-Union, Exempt

Position Summary

The Community Wellness Department’s program goals include maximizing the quality of the member experience and clinical outcomes. This is achieved through an integrated, team-oriented, strengths-based holistic healthcare approach. CWD incorporates prevention, community-engagement and cultural-competence, and integration of behavioral health treatment with a particular focus on the local urban Native American community. This approach allows staff and trainees to develop their skills and creates an environment conducive to professional growth and intercultural proficiency.

The Program Manager I (PM I) provides management, support, and implementation of grants within the Community Wellness Department, across multiple sites, and may include supervision of staff members to execute a scope of work. The incumbent plays the primary role in the development and implementation of site programming to ensure attainment of successful internal and grant outcomes including improved community access, system navigation, program sustainability and integration of services. The PM I is responsible for facilitating implementation and delivery of culturally-based prevention activities and afterschool learning curriculum, including groups, cultural activities, and linkages to traditional knowledge and resources across both NAHC sites and with

collaborating partners. Additionally, the PM I will be responsible for supervision, leadership, and guidance to the CWD team and oversight of youth engagement and program development. This might also include supervision of volunteers and interns, financial management, event planning, and strategy development.

The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).

Duties And Responsibilities

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT: Responsible for envisioning and facilitating development of a program team, articulating its goals and strategy, and reporting

on its outputs.

Work with community and staff to determine unmet community services and program needs. Develop new funding, processes, curriculum, projects and

approaches in response. Facilitate community advisory councils and use information to inform work.

Communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders to integrate and align CWD services across other NAHC departments and ensure compliance with

department, agency and funding agency regulations.

Analyze and improve workflow processes for the program.
Develop annual program work plans in achievement of the program goals and grant deliverables
Manage all administrative functions connected to program area; including mandatory reports, supervision notes, and funder needs.
Adhere to NAHC administrative policy and procedures for check requisitions, travel requisitions, petty cash, etc.
Coordinate project staff through regular meetings and communications.
Proactively plan for audits, site visits, and reporting. Review audit agenda and materials, collect necessary documents and collate information in a presentable manner.
Provide coaching, mentorship and training opportunities to staff within your program area on an ongoing and regular basis. Ensure staff stay current on latest programming trends and best practices.
Address performance issues with staff in a proactive manner consistent with NAHC policy and procedures. Provide training opportunities and corrective

actions to improve performance and build staff capacity.

Ensure meaningful participation by family, youth, and community members in prevention and evaluation processes via design, interpretation, and

dissemination of findings.

Represent the program in meetings, task forces, and partner collaborations.
Work in concert with Research and Evaluation team to ensure that all required data strategies, collection, and documentation of program objectives and

outcomes occur.

Assist in creation and implementation of methodologies, process improvements, and evaluation action plans to improve program operations, outcomes, and quality.
Work in concert with the Communications Team to ensure the social media and outreach strategy objectives are met. Develop compelling campaigns to further expand and promote services and visibility.
Responsible for promoting community events, groups, and other activities across multiple sites, across NAHC, and at outreach events.
Responsible for timely and accurate reporting and documentation of community events, groups, and program activities for regular reports to leadership and funders.
Coordinate activities with collaborating agencies involved in federal, state and local projects and workgroups aimed at policy change in community health.
Serve as a representative of NAHC to grant funders and community stakeholders
Work with supervisor on analysis and improvement of workflow processes for the grant, analysis of staffing structure, making recommendations for program improvements and implementing changes.
Engage in youth-oriented initiatives as needed to advance program development and expansion.
Provide direct services to youth, including program coverage for member facing staff.
Conduct project-related community meetings, workshops and trainings as required for project direction and evaluation, and ensure that these meetings

operate in a timely and effective manner.

Provide leadership on program development and expansion of program activities
Refer participants and their families to appropriate community agencies or facilities; acts as liaison with such organizations and advocates for patients

and/or their families.

Manage program volunteers (i.e. outreach, YAB, Workforce Development, etc.) including development of individual learning and project plans.
Setup trainings and classes for staff and community members on program specific knowledge to build skills and familiarity in specific program.
GRANT ADMINISTRATION: Implement and manage a grant program(s), including budget oversight, implementation reporting, sustainability and evaluation support.
Demonstrate understanding of grant deliverables, timelines, allowable expenses, funding requirements and staff capacity; make decisions accordingly.
Become familiar with grant management and processes and procedures set forth by NAHC
Responsible for meeting project objectives, reporting and other compliance requirements.
Work with supervisor to ensure grant and contract compliance.
In conjunction with supervisor, ensure contract project budgets for the grant are managed in compliance with funders and agency guidelines.
Lead and facilitate a monthly project status meeting with key grant stakeholders to communicate client outcomes, discuss communication plans, review program timeline and performance, raise new quality improvement (QI) initiatives, monitor confidentiality and security and address changes in access/use/outcome disparities within the sub-population.
Identify and ensure the incorporation of culturally appropriate evidence-based practices.
Assist with post award annual reporting (such as renewals, continuations and carryovers), participate in relevant committees, and submit monthly Board of

Director reports.

Maintain regular communications with funding agencies through e-mail, telephone calls, and written reports.
SUPERVISION, TRAINING, REPRESENTATION & COLLABORATION: Responsible for supervision, mentorship, leadership, and guidance to staff

members on the Community Wellness Department team through supervision.

Attend required ongoing Program Manager meetings
Supervise staff on an ongoing basis to ensue your team stays on task and support growth
Must process and submit timesheets for hourly staff on a regular basis and

GENERAL DUTIES

Member Care: Demonstrate understanding and apply working knowledge of safety policies and ensuring safe member practices.
Quality Improvement: Actively participate in internal quality improvement teams and work with members proactively to drive quality improvement initiatives in accordance with the mission and strategic goals of the organization, federal and state laws and regulations, and accreditation standards, when assigned.
Resolve staffing issues and facilitate conflict resolution for staff under direct supervision. Hire, discipline, evaluate and terminate staff in coordination with the Human Resources department.
Foster a team environment to effectively lead and retain your staff.
Supervise staff on an ongoing basis to ensure your team stays on task and support growth
Must maintain compliance with ergonomic safety standards; be mindful of posture and regularly practice ergonomic stretches.
Safety: Responsible for ensuring that all duties, responsibilities and operations are performed with the utmost regard for the safety and health of all personnel involved, including themselves.
Safety: Take appropriate corrective actions to address matters pertaining to employee health and safety that have been brought to their attention.
HIPAA: Keep all protected health information (PHI) confidential and abide by HIPAA guidelines for the release and disclosure of any PHI. Will report

unauthorized use of disclosure of PHI immediately, to Site Director and HIPAA security officer.

HIPAA: Ensure the protection of all PHI and compliance of HIPAA guidelines

amongst staff under your supervision. Take appropriate steps to address HIPAA concerns with staff as necessary.

Works extremely well under pressure, meet multiple and often competing deadlines.
At all times demonstrate cooperative behavior with supervisors, subordinates, colleagues, clients and the community.
Other duties as assigned by Supervisor and Director of Community Wellness Department.

jobs.title: Vulnerability and Patching Program Manager
jobs.description:
Experienced Patch Manager to lead the coordination and continuous improvement of our global patching and vulnerability-remediation program. This role will partner with Infrastructure, Cyber & Information Security, regional and plant IT, manufacturing operations, application owners, OT teams, and service providers to ensure security updates and mitigating controls are implemented on time and with appropriate consideration for system stability, production schedules, safety, and business continuity.

This is a highly visible individual-contributor role for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with disciplined program management and the ability to influence teams without direct authority. The Patch Manager will establish accountability, follow up on commitments, remove barriers, maintain reliable reporting and evidence, and escalate material risk when objectives are not met.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the global patch-management calendar, governance cadence, procedures, RACI, action register, dashboards, and continuous-improvement roadmap.

Coordinate routine and emergency patch cycles across endpoints, servers, network devices, cloud platforms, applications, manufacturing systems, shop-floor technology, and supported OT environments.

Partner with Security to prioritize remediation using exploitability, severity, asset criticality, exposure, business impact, and available compensating controls.

Work with plants and technical owners to establish practical testing, maintenance-window, reboot, rollback, and post-deployment validation plans.

Track remediation commitments to verified closure; resolve ownership gaps and escalate overdue critical exposure, recurring failures, or unacceptable exceptions.

Ensure exceptions are formally assessed, approved, time-bound, and supported by documented mitigating controls.

Reconcile patching, vulnerability, and asset data to identify unmanaged systems, reporting gaps, failed deployments, and unsupported technology.

Provide concise operational and executive reporting and maintain evidence for audits, customer requirements, and control assessments.

Build strong relationships across global teams and coach stakeholders on patching expectations, evidence standards, and effective tool use.

Requirements :
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline.
• Equivalent combination of relevant post-secondary education, recognized technical training, and substantial directly related experience may be considered.
• Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, endpoint engineering, systems administration, vulnerability management, cybersecurity operations, or a closely related technical discipline.
• Prefer 1 year minimum of direct responsibility for coordinating or leading patch management, vulnerability remediation, infrastructure operations, or a comparable global technology-control process.
• Demonstrated experience working across multiple technology teams and geographically distributed locations; manufacturing, industrial, or other high-availability operational environments is strongly preferred.
• Practical experience coordinating changes that require testing, maintenance windows, rollback planning, post-change validation, and stakeholder communication.
• Experience managing remediation backlogs, exceptions, action trackers, dashboards, and evidence for audits or customer requirements.

The Regional Program Manager (RPM) owns delivery of the ERTS Commercial Compliance Program within an assigned multi-state region. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. We are solving tough problems through innovation and proven methodology – come be part of the solution with us.

This position is located and supports the Eastern Region of the US.

Health and Safety is our #1 priority and we live it 3-6-5!
Focus on maintaining sustainability and cleaning the Earth

Own part of the company with our Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Opportunities for growth and development for all the stages of your career
Company paid training and tuition reimbursement

Program and Client Management

Manage all Commercial Compliance Program accounts in the region: onboarding, annual service calendars, scheduling of site visits, and delivery of services.

9+ years' technical experience in cybersecurity or information technology
DoD 8570 IAT/IAM Level I/II certification

Citymesh is niet zomaar een telecombedrijf. Als 4e telecomoperator en 'Techco powerhouse' hertekenen we het B2B-telecomlandschap van 0G tot 5G. Van private 5G-netwerken op Brussels Airport, de Haven van Zeebrugge en bij BASF, tot kritische connectiviteit op Tomorrowland en autonome safety-drones: wij vertalen technologie naar échte operationele impact. End-to-end verantwoordelijkheid: Je beheert de end-to-end oplevering van klantprojecten binnen de domeinen Private Mobile Networks, LAN/WLAN en/of mogelijke toepassingen op deze netwerken. About This Role

Utilise your strategic intelligence experience in a correctional or law enforcement setting.
Ongoing, Full time opportunity.
VPS grade 4: $100,894 - $114,476 plus superannuation.

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is seeking an Intelligence Analyst to provide a critical role at Melbourne Assessment Prison Precinct.

About The Business Unit

The Melbourne Assessment Prison Precinct (MAPP) is a maximum-security correctional facility located on the fringe of the Melbourne CBD. The MAPP is the State's primary reception prison, receiving prisoners directly from the Courts and Police and provides assessment and orientation services for all male prisoners received into the prison system. The MAPP also operates the Melbourne County Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Court Appeals facilities, located on the corners of William and Lonsdale Streets in the CBD and St Augustine's secure medical ward, located at St Vincent's Hospital. These facilities manage both male and female prisoners of all security ratings, operating Monday to Friday. The location also manages the St Vincent's Hospital holding cells, providing custodial liaison and coordination of all prisoner escorts attending the hospital for medical outpatient appointments from prison locations across the State. MAPP also looks after the security function at the Adult Parole Board and the Post Sentence Authority located at 50 Franklin Street, West Melbourne.

Corrections Victoria Intelligence Service (CVIS) is the overarching intelligence service for Corrections Victoria and its stakeholders. Presently the CVIS comprises the primary intelligence unit known as the Corrections Victoria Intelligence Unit (CVIU), and Prison Intelligence Unit's (PIU) located at the twelve public and two private prison facilities in Victoria.

About The Role

The position of Corrections Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for collecting, recording, analysing and disseminating information, with a specific focus on high security prisoners, to identify potential prisoner incidents/unrest, prevent prisoner escapes, and prevent the introduction and usage of contraband within CV facilities.

This position reports to the Supervisor (PIU), and will contribute to both tactical and strategic intelligence functions, and analyse and present intelligence information to management and authorised persons/external agencies as required.

This position is created to support prison management in maintaining the security, good order and management of prison facilities.

Some Of Your Duties Will Include

Lead the collation, analysis, and controlled dissemination and reporting of intelligence information, specifically in relation to high security prisoners, to authorised parties, in a timely manner.
Prepare and present intelligence briefings, and make high quality recommendations, in respect of the analysis of intelligence data, including the identification and evaluation of emerging threats, opportunities, patterns and trends relating to the activities of high security prisoners which affect the security and good order of the prison system.
Support prison management, staff and external agencies by participating in the development and planning of intelligence-led prison operations.

To learn more about this role before applying, please read the attached position description.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Demonstrated experience in delivering both tactical and strategic intelligence functions in a correctional or law enforcement setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary principles and practises that apply to intelligence functions within the criminal justice system and across intelligence agencies.
Experience in, or capacity to quickly learn and use, Corrections Victoria and Department of Justice and Community Safety systems and applications.

Qualifications/requirements

Experience with the Centurion Intelligence system (desirable).

How To Apply

Please click the Apply button on this advertisement. Applications should include a resume and covering letter. Attachments can be uploaded in .doc, .docx, .pdf, .txt or .rtf formats.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, nationally coordinated criminal history checks (NCCHC), and misconduct screening. Dependant on the role, other checks may include VicRoads checks, drivers licence checks, medical checks, Working with Children Checks, and Declaration of Private Interests (for executive and responsible officer roles).

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

Important Information

CHILD SAFE STATEMENT OF COMMITMENT:

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is committed to the safety and wellbeing of children and young people. Senior Cyber Threat Analyst / Threat Detection Engineer

Location: Canberra, ACT
Work arrangement: Hybrid
Contract: 12 months with up to 2 x 12-month extension options
Hours: Up to 40 hours per week
Expected commencement: 17 October 2026
Experience level: Senior / APS6 equivalent
Security clearance: Current Baseline or the ability to obtain one

Azooa is seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Threat Analyst / Threat Detection Engineer for a long-term contract supporting an Australian Government client.

This is a hands-on detection engineering role focused on designing, implementing and continuously improving enterprise threat-detection capabilities across SIEM, SOAR and EDR platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will develop high-quality detection content, integrate security platforms, automate incident-response workflows and apply threat intelligence and threat-modelling techniques to strengthen enterprise security operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain detection content across enterprise SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar and Elastic Security.
• Create detection rules, queries, dashboards and security use cases.
• Integrate detection capabilities across SIEM, SOAR and EDR technologies.
• Develop and maintain automated response workflows and incident-response playbooks.
• Conduct threat modelling using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, STRIDE or PASTA.
• Apply cyber-threat intelligence to detection engineering and security operations.
• Improve alert quality, reduce false positives and strengthen detection coverage.
• Support threat hunting, incident response and security investigations.
• Develop monitoring for emerging AI-related threats, including prompt injection, data leakage and model abuse.
• Produce technical documentation, operational procedures and detection-engineering guidance.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• At least five years of cybersecurity operations experience.
• Hands-on experience developing detection content across at least two enterprise SIEM platforms.
• Experience integrating SIEM, SOAR and EDR technologies.
• Experience developing automation workflows or incident-response playbooks.
• Practical knowledge of threat modelling and cyber-threat intelligence.
• Strong scripting, analytical and technical-documentation capabilities.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-engagement skills.

HIGHLY REGARDED

Experience with one or more of the following will be advantageous:

• Sigma detection rules.
• Microsoft Defender.
• CrowdStrike.
• VMware Carbon Black.
• Cortex XSOAR or similar SOAR platforms.
• KQL, Python, PowerShell or Bash.
• Australian Government security environments.
• AI security monitoring and detection.

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must be Australian citizens and hold a current Baseline clearance or be eligible to obtain one. Eligible Australian citizens may be sponsored for a new Baseline clearance.

Candidates holding NV1, NV2, PV or TSPV clearances may also apply, although the engagement may not maintain a clearance above Baseline.

WORKING ARRANGEMENTS

The role is based in Canberra and classified as hybrid. Interstate remote work may be considered case by case, subject to operational requirements.

RATE GUIDANCE

Azooa's recommended maximum candidate rate is up to $165 per hour, including super. A rate around $140 per hour, including super, would provide a particularly competitive value-for-money position.

Candidates contracting through an ABN or ACN should provide their proposed hourly rate excluding GST. Strong candidates with higher rate expectations are still encouraged to apply.

ABOUT AZOOA

Azooa is an Australian technology, consulting and professional-services company supporting complex Federal Government programs. We work closely with experienced professionals to identify suitable opportunities, prepare competitive submissions and provide ongoing contractor support.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Please apply with:

• Your current CV or resume.
• Current residential location.
• Security-clearance level or confirmation that you can obtain Baseline.
• Availability and earliest commencement date.
• Expected hourly rate, including super for PAYG or excluding GST for ABN/ACN arrangements.

Memiliki pengalaman kerja 2–5 tahun pada bidang Telecom Data Analytics, Network Performance, Network Quality, atau Core Network.
Berpengalaman dalam analisis performa jaringan telekomunikasi dan customer experience analytics.

Technical Skills

Memahami konsep dasar jaringan telekomunikasi seluler, traffic flow, service quality, latency, throughput, packet loss, availability, dan customer experience.
Memiliki pemahaman mengenai arsitektur dan komponen 4G/5G Core Network (EPC/5GC).
Mampu menganalisis KPI Core Network dan Quality of Service (QoS) seperti latency, throughput, packet loss, accessibility, availability, utilization, dan traffic.

Menguasai SQL untuk data extraction, join, aggregation, filtering, time-based analysis, serta pengolahan dataset telecom dalam skala besar.

Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan tools visualisasi data seperti Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, atau Grafana.

Crowdsourced Data Analytics

Berpengalaman menggunakan platform crowdsourced network data seperti Opensignal (ONX), Ookla Speedtest, nPerf, atau platform serupa.
Mampu melakukan analisis KPI QoE (Quality of Experience) seperti download speed, upload speed, latency, packet loss, coverage, dan availability.
Mampu menghubungkan dan mengkorelasikan data crowdsourced QoE dengan KPI internal network, PM, CDR/xDR, OSS/NMS, traffic data, serta data geografis dan temporal.

Analytical & Problem Solving Skills

Memiliki kemampuan geospatial analytics untuk menganalisis kualitas jaringan berdasarkan lokasi, area, region, site, atau cell.

Reporting & Communication

Mampu menyusun dashboard monitoring KPI dan menghasilkan laporan analisis yang jelas serta actionable recommendations.
Mampu menerjemahkan data network dan customer experience menjadi insight bisnis dan teknis yang mudah dipahami stakeholder.
Mampu berkoordinasi dengan tim Network, NOC, Engineering, Operations, dan Data/IT.

Nilai Tambah (Preferred)

Memiliki pengalaman proyek terkait Core Network Quality atau Network Performance Analytics.
Memiliki pengalaman membangun dashboard KPI/QoE dengan drill-down analysis.
Memiliki pengalaman melakukan correlation analysis antara customer experience dan network performance.

Job Title: Business Analyst II
Job Description

The Business Analyst II leads the onboarding of key forecasting modelsincluding promo sign-ups, subscription churn, and total customersinto a financial forecasting platform built on TM1 and related planning tools. This role serves as the primary bridge between Finance stakeholders and TM1 engineering, translating finance reporting requirements and model logic into clear technical specifications, coordinating implementation, and owning user acceptance testing. The Business Analyst II also produces thorough documentation for each model build and enhancement, and establishes a repeatable framework for onboarding new models into the forecasting platform.

Responsibilities

Gather and document detailed finance reporting requirements from Finance stakeholders and translate them into precise technical specifications for TM1 and associated planning tool implementations.
Define data requirements and source-data contracts for each forecasting model, identifying gaps between existing Finance Excel models and current system capabilities, and proposing solutions within TM1 and planning tool constraints.
Design and wireframe user interfaces and user experiences for forecast adjustments to ensure that users can easily access only the adjustments they need to make, with complete reporting visibility after updates.
Partner closely with TM1 engineering teams to design, build, test, and deploy updates to Finance models within the TM1 and planning analytics environment.
Develop and execute comprehensive user acceptance testing (UAT) plans, validating that cube changes and model updates produce accurate and financially correct outputs before release to production.
Document business rules, calculation logic, and data lineage for all onboarded forecasting dimensions to ensure transparency, consistency, and maintainability.
Identify gaps in platform validation checks and collaborate with TM1 and planning tool teams, Data Science, and Data Engineering to strengthen validation and data quality controls.
Trace metric discrepancies across multiple reporting surfaces back to pipeline-level or cube-level root causes, and work with relevant teams to resolve issues.
Own the TM1 engineering ticket queue end to end, including intake, tracking, and closure of tickets, while prioritizing strategic work and new issues based on business impact in partnership with the Finance team.
Maintain clear, structured documentation and communication around model changes, data requirements, and workflow improvements to support ongoing platform evolution.

Essential Skills

4 to 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst working with finance systems or enterprise planning tools.
Proven experience translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications for engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to assess existing business processes and design improved workflows, including creating wireframes and UI/UX proposals.
Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, and scenario analysis.
Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to query relational databases to validate data and trace data lineage.
Experience with planning, executing, and documenting user acceptance testing (UAT).
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solid understanding of financial reporting and forecasting concepts, with the ability to support accurate and reliable financial outputs.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience with TM1, Planning Analytics, or similar enterprise planning and forecasting tools.
Familiarity with ETL pipelines and data warehouse concepts, including platforms such as Redshift, Andes, or comparable technologies.
Knowledge of FP&A concepts, including forecasting, actuals versus plan variance analysis, and dimensional modeling.
Experience working within media, streaming, or subscription-based business models.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Finance stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in Culver City and follows a standard full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. The position operates within a collaborative office environment that works closely with Finance, TM1 engineering, Data Science, and Data Engineering teams. The work focuses on financial forecasting, data analysis, and model implementation within TM1 and related planning tools, with regular interaction across technical and business functions.

This is a Contract position based out of Los Angeles, CA.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities

Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it

About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!

5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question

Working Style

Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go

Nice-to-Haves

Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background

About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?

We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan

Position Summary

The Community Wellness Department’s program goals include maximizing the quality of the member experience and clinical outcomes. This is achieved through an integrated, team-oriented, strengths-based holistic healthcare approach. CWD incorporates prevention, community-engagement and cultural-competence, and integration of behavioral health treatment with a particular focus on the local urban Native American community. This approach allows staff and trainees to develop their skills and creates an environment conducive to professional growth and intercultural proficiency.

The Program Manager I (PM I) provides management, support, and implementation of grants within the Community Wellness Department, across multiple sites, and may include supervision of staff members to execute a scope of work. The incumbent plays the primary role in the development and implementation of site programming to ensure attainment of successful internal and grant outcomes including improved community access, system navigation, program sustainability and integration of services. The PM I is responsible for facilitating implementation and delivery of culturally-based prevention activities and afterschool learning curriculum, including groups, cultural activities, and linkages to traditional knowledge and resources across both NAHC sites and with

collaborating partners. Additionally, the PM I will be responsible for supervision, leadership, and guidance to the CWD team and oversight of youth engagement and program development. This might also include supervision of volunteers and interns, financial management, event planning, and strategy development.

The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).

Duties And Responsibilities

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT: Responsible for envisioning and facilitating development of a program team, articulating its goals and strategy, and reporting

on its outputs.

Work with community and staff to determine unmet community services and program needs. Develop new funding, processes, curriculum, projects and

approaches in response. Facilitate community advisory councils and use information to inform work.

Communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders to integrate and align CWD services across other NAHC departments and ensure compliance with

department, agency and funding agency regulations.

Analyze and improve workflow processes for the program.
Develop annual program work plans in achievement of the program goals and grant deliverables
Manage all administrative functions connected to program area; including mandatory reports, supervision notes, and funder needs.
Adhere to NAHC administrative policy and procedures for check requisitions, travel requisitions, petty cash, etc.
Coordinate project staff through regular meetings and communications.
Proactively plan for audits, site visits, and reporting. Review audit agenda and materials, collect necessary documents and collate information in a presentable manner.
Provide coaching, mentorship and training opportunities to staff within your program area on an ongoing and regular basis. Ensure staff stay current on latest programming trends and best practices.
Address performance issues with staff in a proactive manner consistent with NAHC policy and procedures. Provide training opportunities and corrective

actions to improve performance and build staff capacity.

Ensure meaningful participation by family, youth, and community members in prevention and evaluation processes via design, interpretation, and

dissemination of findings.

Represent the program in meetings, task forces, and partner collaborations.
Work in concert with Research and Evaluation team to ensure that all required data strategies, collection, and documentation of program objectives and

outcomes occur.

Assist in creation and implementation of methodologies, process improvements, and evaluation action plans to improve program operations, outcomes, and quality.
Work in concert with the Communications Team to ensure the social media and outreach strategy objectives are met. Develop compelling campaigns to further expand and promote services and visibility.
Responsible for promoting community events, groups, and other activities across multiple sites, across NAHC, and at outreach events.
Responsible for timely and accurate reporting and documentation of community events, groups, and program activities for regular reports to leadership and funders.
Coordinate activities with collaborating agencies involved in federal, state and local projects and workgroups aimed at policy change in community health.
Serve as a representative of NAHC to grant funders and community stakeholders
Work with supervisor on analysis and improvement of workflow processes for the grant, analysis of staffing structure, making recommendations for program improvements and implementing changes.
Engage in youth-oriented initiatives as needed to advance program development and expansion.
Provide direct services to youth, including program coverage for member facing staff.
Conduct project-related community meetings, workshops and trainings as required for project direction and evaluation, and ensure that these meetings

operate in a timely and effective manner.

Provide leadership on program development and expansion of program activities
Refer participants and their families to appropriate community agencies or facilities; acts as liaison with such organizations and advocates for patients

and/or their families.

Manage program volunteers (i.e. outreach, YAB, Workforce Development, etc.) including development of individual learning and project plans.
Setup trainings and classes for staff and community members on program specific knowledge to build skills and familiarity in specific program.
GRANT ADMINISTRATION: Implement and manage a grant program(s), including budget oversight, implementation reporting, sustainability and evaluation support.
Demonstrate understanding of grant deliverables, timelines, allowable expenses, funding requirements and staff capacity; make decisions accordingly.
Become familiar with grant management and processes and procedures set forth by NAHC
Responsible for meeting project objectives, reporting and other compliance requirements.
Work with supervisor to ensure grant and contract compliance.
In conjunction with supervisor, ensure contract project budgets for the grant are managed in compliance with funders and agency guidelines.
Lead and facilitate a monthly project status meeting with key grant stakeholders to communicate client outcomes, discuss communication plans, review program timeline and performance, raise new quality improvement (QI) initiatives, monitor confidentiality and security and address changes in access/use/outcome disparities within the sub-population.
Identify and ensure the incorporation of culturally appropriate evidence-based practices.
Assist with post award annual reporting (such as renewals, continuations and carryovers), participate in relevant committees, and submit monthly Board of

Director reports.

Maintain regular communications with funding agencies through e-mail, telephone calls, and written reports.
SUPERVISION, TRAINING, REPRESENTATION & COLLABORATION: Responsible for supervision, mentorship, leadership, and guidance to staff

members on the Community Wellness Department team through supervision.

Attend required ongoing Program Manager meetings
Supervise staff on an ongoing basis to ensue your team stays on task and support growth
Must process and submit timesheets for hourly staff on a regular basis and

GENERAL DUTIES

Member Care: Demonstrate understanding and apply working knowledge of safety policies and ensuring safe member practices.
Quality Improvement: Actively participate in internal quality improvement teams and work with members proactively to drive quality improvement initiatives in accordance with the mission and strategic goals of the organization, federal and state laws and regulations, and accreditation standards, when assigned.
Resolve staffing issues and facilitate conflict resolution for staff under direct supervision. Hire, discipline, evaluate and terminate staff in coordination with the Human Resources department.
Foster a team environment to effectively lead and retain your staff.
Supervise staff on an ongoing basis to ensure your team stays on task and support growth
Must maintain compliance with ergonomic safety standards; be mindful of posture and regularly practice ergonomic stretches.

HIPAA: Ensure the protection of all PHI and compliance of HIPAA guidelines

Works extremely well under pressure, meet multiple and often competing deadlines.

Experienced Patch Manager to lead the coordination and continuous improvement of our global patching and vulnerability-remediation program. This role will partner with Infrastructure, Cyber & Information Security, regional and plant IT, manufacturing operations, application owners, OT teams, and service providers to ensure security updates and mitigating controls are implemented on time and with appropriate consideration for system stability, production schedules, safety, and business continuity.

This is a highly visible individual-contributor role for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with disciplined program management and the ability to influence teams without direct authority. The Patch Manager will establish accountability, follow up on commitments, remove barriers, maintain reliable reporting and evidence, and escalate material risk when objectives are not met.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the global patch-management calendar, governance cadence, procedures, RACI, action register, dashboards, and continuous-improvement roadmap.

Coordinate routine and emergency patch cycles across endpoints, servers, network devices, cloud platforms, applications, manufacturing systems, shop-floor technology, and supported OT environments.

Partner with Security to prioritize remediation using exploitability, severity, asset criticality, exposure, business impact, and available compensating controls.

Work with plants and technical owners to establish practical testing, maintenance-window, reboot, rollback, and post-deployment validation plans.

Track remediation commitments to verified closure; resolve ownership gaps and escalate overdue critical exposure, recurring failures, or unacceptable exceptions.

Ensure exceptions are formally assessed, approved, time-bound, and supported by documented mitigating controls.

Reconcile patching, vulnerability, and asset data to identify unmanaged systems, reporting gaps, failed deployments, and unsupported technology.

Provide concise operational and executive reporting and maintain evidence for audits, customer requirements, and control assessments.

Build strong relationships across global teams and coach stakeholders on patching expectations, evidence standards, and effective tool use.

• Equivalent combination of relevant post-secondary education, recognized technical training, and substantial directly related experience may be considered.
• Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, endpoint engineering, systems administration, vulnerability management, cybersecurity operations, or a closely related technical discipline.

About This Role

Utilise your strategic intelligence experience in a correctional or law enforcement setting.
Ongoing, Full time opportunity.
VPS grade 4: $100,894 - $114,476 plus superannuation.

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is seeking an Intelligence Analyst to provide a critical role at Melbourne Assessment Prison Precinct.

About The Business Unit

The Melbourne Assessment Prison Precinct (MAPP) is a maximum-security correctional facility located on the fringe of the Melbourne CBD. The MAPP is the State's primary reception prison, receiving prisoners directly from the Courts and Police and provides assessment and orientation services for all male prisoners received into the prison system. The MAPP also operates the Melbourne County Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Court Appeals facilities, located on the corners of William and Lonsdale Streets in the CBD and St Augustine's secure medical ward, located at St Vincent's Hospital. These facilities manage both male and female prisoners of all security ratings, operating Monday to Friday. The location also manages the St Vincent's Hospital holding cells, providing custodial liaison and coordination of all prisoner escorts attending the hospital for medical outpatient appointments from prison locations across the State. MAPP also looks after the security function at the Adult Parole Board and the Post Sentence Authority located at 50 Franklin Street, West Melbourne.

Corrections Victoria Intelligence Service (CVIS) is the overarching intelligence service for Corrections Victoria and its stakeholders. Presently the CVIS comprises the primary intelligence unit known as the Corrections Victoria Intelligence Unit (CVIU), and Prison Intelligence Unit's (PIU) located at the twelve public and two private prison facilities in Victoria.

About The Role

The position of Corrections Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for collecting, recording, analysing and disseminating information, with a specific focus on high security prisoners, to identify potential prisoner incidents/unrest, prevent prisoner escapes, and prevent the introduction and usage of contraband within CV facilities.

This position reports to the Supervisor (PIU), and will contribute to both tactical and strategic intelligence functions, and analyse and present intelligence information to management and authorised persons/external agencies as required.

This position is created to support prison management in maintaining the security, good order and management of prison facilities.

Some Of Your Duties Will Include

Lead the collation, analysis, and controlled dissemination and reporting of intelligence information, specifically in relation to high security prisoners, to authorised parties, in a timely manner.
Prepare and present intelligence briefings, and make high quality recommendations, in respect of the analysis of intelligence data, including the identification and evaluation of emerging threats, opportunities, patterns and trends relating to the activities of high security prisoners which affect the security and good order of the prison system.
Support prison management, staff and external agencies by participating in the development and planning of intelligence-led prison operations.

To learn more about this role before applying, please read the attached position description.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Demonstrated experience in delivering both tactical and strategic intelligence functions in a correctional or law enforcement setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary principles and practises that apply to intelligence functions within the criminal justice system and across intelligence agencies.
Experience in, or capacity to quickly learn and use, Corrections Victoria and Department of Justice and Community Safety systems and applications.

Qualifications/requirements

Experience with the Centurion Intelligence system (desirable).

How To Apply

Please click the Apply button on this advertisement. Applications should include a resume and covering letter. Attachments can be uploaded in .doc, .docx, .pdf, .txt or .rtf formats.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo pre-employment checks which may include reference checks, nationally coordinated criminal history checks (NCCHC), and misconduct screening. Dependant on the role, other checks may include VicRoads checks, drivers licence checks, medical checks, Working with Children Checks, and Declaration of Private Interests (for executive and responsible officer roles).

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

Important Information

CHILD SAFE STATEMENT OF COMMITMENT:

The Department of Justice and Community Safety is committed to the safety and wellbeing of children and young people. We seek to prevent harm of any kind impacting children and young people and have zero tolerance for racism, child abuse and inequality. Children and young people's rights, relationships, identity, and culture must be recognised and respected, their voices heard, and their concerns acted upon. We aim to foster a culturally safe, child safe and child friendly environment for all children and young people we have contact with, deliver services to, or are impacted by our work.
