Azooa is seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Threat Analyst / Threat Detection Engineer for a long-term contract supporting an Australian Government client.

This is a hands-on detection engineering role focused on designing, implementing and continuously improving enterprise threat-detection capabilities across SIEM, SOAR and EDR platforms.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will develop high-quality detection content, integrate security platforms, automate incident-response workflows and apply threat intelligence and threat-modelling techniques to strengthen enterprise security operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain detection content across enterprise SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar and Elastic Security.
• Create detection rules, queries, dashboards and security use cases.
• Integrate detection capabilities across SIEM, SOAR and EDR technologies.
• Develop and maintain automated response workflows and incident-response playbooks.
• Conduct threat modelling using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, STRIDE or PASTA.
• Apply cyber-threat intelligence to detection engineering and security operations.
• Improve alert quality, reduce false positives and strengthen detection coverage.
• Support threat hunting, incident response and security investigations.
• Develop monitoring for emerging AI-related threats, including prompt injection, data leakage and model abuse.
• Produce technical documentation, operational procedures and detection-engineering guidance.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• At least five years of cybersecurity operations experience.
• Hands-on experience developing detection content across at least two enterprise SIEM platforms.
• Experience integrating SIEM, SOAR and EDR technologies.
• Experience developing automation workflows or incident-response playbooks.
• Practical knowledge of threat modelling and cyber-threat intelligence.
• Strong scripting, analytical and technical-documentation capabilities.
• Strong communication and stakeholder-engagement skills.

HIGHLY REGARDED

Experience with one or more of the following will be advantageous:

• Sigma detection rules.
• Microsoft Defender.
• CrowdStrike.
• VMware Carbon Black.
• Cortex XSOAR or similar SOAR platforms.
• KQL, Python, PowerShell or Bash.
• Australian Government security environments.
• AI security monitoring and detection.

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must be Australian citizens and hold a current Baseline clearance or be eligible to obtain one. Eligible Australian citizens may be sponsored for a new Baseline clearance.

Candidates holding NV1, NV2, PV or TSPV clearances may also apply, although the engagement may not maintain a clearance above Baseline.

WORKING ARRANGEMENTS

The role is based in Canberra and classified as hybrid. Interstate remote work may be considered case by case, subject to operational requirements.

RATE GUIDANCE

Azooa's recommended maximum candidate rate is up to $165 per hour, including super. A rate around $140 per hour, including super, would provide a particularly competitive value-for-money position.

Candidates contracting through an ABN or ACN should provide their proposed hourly rate excluding GST. Strong candidates with higher rate expectations are still encouraged to apply.

ABOUT AZOOA

Azooa is an Australian technology, consulting and professional-services company supporting complex Federal Government programs. We work closely with experienced professionals to identify suitable opportunities, prepare competitive submissions and provide ongoing contractor support.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

• Your current CV or resume.

Job Title: Business Analyst II
Job Description

The Business Analyst II leads the onboarding of key forecasting modelsincluding promo sign-ups, subscription churn, and total customersinto a financial forecasting platform built on TM1 and related planning tools. This role serves as the primary bridge between Finance stakeholders and TM1 engineering, translating finance reporting requirements and model logic into clear technical specifications, coordinating implementation, and owning user acceptance testing. The Business Analyst II also produces thorough documentation for each model build and enhancement, and establishes a repeatable framework for onboarding new models into the forecasting platform.

Responsibilities

Gather and document detailed finance reporting requirements from Finance stakeholders and translate them into precise technical specifications for TM1 and associated planning tool implementations.
Define data requirements and source-data contracts for each forecasting model, identifying gaps between existing Finance Excel models and current system capabilities, and proposing solutions within TM1 and planning tool constraints.
Design and wireframe user interfaces and user experiences for forecast adjustments to ensure that users can easily access only the adjustments they need to make, with complete reporting visibility after updates.
Partner closely with TM1 engineering teams to design, build, test, and deploy updates to Finance models within the TM1 and planning analytics environment.
Develop and execute comprehensive user acceptance testing (UAT) plans, validating that cube changes and model updates produce accurate and financially correct outputs before release to production.
Document business rules, calculation logic, and data lineage for all onboarded forecasting dimensions to ensure transparency, consistency, and maintainability.
Identify gaps in platform validation checks and collaborate with TM1 and planning tool teams, Data Science, and Data Engineering to strengthen validation and data quality controls.
Trace metric discrepancies across multiple reporting surfaces back to pipeline-level or cube-level root causes, and work with relevant teams to resolve issues.
Own the TM1 engineering ticket queue end to end, including intake, tracking, and closure of tickets, while prioritizing strategic work and new issues based on business impact in partnership with the Finance team.
Maintain clear, structured documentation and communication around model changes, data requirements, and workflow improvements to support ongoing platform evolution.

Essential Skills

4 to 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst working with finance systems or enterprise planning tools.
Proven experience translating business requirements into detailed technical specifications for engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to assess existing business processes and design improved workflows, including creating wireframes and UI/UX proposals.
Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, and scenario analysis.
Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to query relational databases to validate data and trace data lineage.
Experience with planning, executing, and documenting user acceptance testing (UAT).
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solid understanding of financial reporting and forecasting concepts, with the ability to support accurate and reliable financial outputs.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience with TM1, Planning Analytics, or similar enterprise planning and forecasting tools.
Familiarity with ETL pipelines and data warehouse concepts, including platforms such as Redshift, Andes, or comparable technologies.
Knowledge of FP&A concepts, including forecasting, actuals versus plan variance analysis, and dimensional modeling.
Experience working within media, streaming, or subscription-based business models.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Data Science, Data Engineering, and Finance stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in Culver City and follows a standard full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. The position operates within a collaborative office environment that works closely with Finance, TM1 engineering, Data Science, and Data Engineering teams. The work focuses on financial forecasting, data analysis, and model implementation within TM1 and related planning tools, with regular interaction across technical and business functions.

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Business Analyst (Agile) based in United States.

This senior role leads business analysis across multiple Agile teams supporting the modernization of a mission-critical federal case management platform.

You will guide Business Analysts, shape enterprise-level product backlogs, and ensure requirements remain aligned with customer objectives and delivery commitments.

The position combines strategic leadership with hands-on work in requirements engineering, process analysis, journey mapping, and business process re-engineering.

You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, architects, testers, developers, stakeholders, and customer representatives.

The role offers the opportunity to influence modernization initiatives spanning complex legacy systems and new cloud-based solutions.

Success requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, communication, and the ability to bring structure to complex business and technical requirements.

This is a fully remote position within a collaborative Agile environment, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Lead and provide guidance to Business Analysts across multiple Scrum teams, ensuring consistent approaches to requirements, backlog management, and delivery.
Own the backlog decomposition strategy and maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog with sufficient work prepared for upcoming sprints.
Partner with Product Owners and customer stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage scope, define objectives, and maintain alignment with product vision and roadmap.
Establish and enforce clear Definitions of Ready and Done across development teams, supporting consistent quality and delivery standards.
Provide transparency into backlog health and decomposition through metrics, dashboards, and regular reporting.
Take a leadership role in Program Increment planning, coordinating dependencies, milestones, deliverables, sequencing, and timelines.
Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks, impediments, and delivery issues, following through until resolution.
Collaborate with architects, testers, Product Owners, developers, and stakeholders to ensure end-to-end alignment across technical and business deliverables.
Lead retrospectives and Communities of Practice for Business Analysts, gathering feedback, encouraging knowledge sharing, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
Develop and maintain business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical documentation, process maps, narratives, and related delivery artifacts.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews, customer journey mapping, process-mapping sessions, and business analysis workshops with project teams and court personnel.
Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for standardization while documenting necessary variations, local rules, and differences across business environments.
Develop detailed process maps and supporting narratives using Microsoft Visio, maintaining documentation in an accessible and hierarchical structure.
Support gap analyses, workflow analysis, alternative solution assessments, business process modeling, wireframes, and storyboards as required.
Generate contractual deliverables and ensure they are completed within agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
Provide business analysis and technical support during Agile ceremonies and contribute journey-mapping, process-analysis, and customer-interview outputs to regular reporting.
Promote continuous improvement across the end-to-end analysis and delivery process, with a strong focus on product quality, requirements alignment, and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

10+ years of experience supporting Product Owners and Agile teams, eliciting business needs, managing backlogs, developing requirements, and maintaining technical documentation.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; a master’s degree is also acceptable.
Proven experience leading or providing guidance to multiple Business Analysts and Agile teams while maintaining alignment with overall program objectives.
Strong experience gathering and translating stakeholder, customer, Product Owner, and end-user needs into detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Experience with Agile methodologies, progressive elaboration of complex technical epics and stories, backlog management, and sprint readiness.
Demonstrated expertise in business process analysis, workflow analysis, process modeling, and business process re-engineering.
Experience supporting modernization initiatives, including legacy IT environments, integrations, new development, and deployment alongside existing systems.
Experience performing gap analyses, workflow assessments, Analysis of Alternatives, business process modeling, wireframes, and storyboards.
Strong technical background and ability to collaborate effectively with Solutions Architects, developers, testers, and senior technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting testing through acceptance criteria development and validation of test-case results.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to formulate and communicate practical recommendations.
Excellent verbal, written, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Consultant mindset with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and diverse audiences.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated ability to identify and apply relevant industry tools, best practices, methods, solutions, and emerging technologies.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a complex Agile delivery environment.

Benefits

Salary: Likely base salary range of $128,039–$173,229 per year, depending on experience, location, and applicable contractual requirements.
Work arrangement: Fully remote, with no travel required.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities

Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it

About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!

5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question

Working Style

Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go

Nice-to-Haves

Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background

About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?

We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan
